title: On the Annunciation (Homily I)
author: Gregory Thaumaturgus
edition: Opera omnia, Greek and Latin (Paris, 1622), Latin column (In annuntiationem Sermo I, printed pp. 9-15); Greek column OCR damaged
blurb: Gregory Thaumaturgus, On the Annunciation: the first sermon, in a fresh English translation. Three sermons survive; this volume covers the first only.
era_note: The Annunciation sermons stand under Gregory Thaumaturgus's name in the Neocaesarean tradition as transmitted by Vossius; later Latin presentation and authenticity questions are disclosed.
first_english_note: Prior English exists (ANF 6 Salmond, PD); this is a fresh English translation of the first sermon from the Latin.

text_history.method: Fresh English translation of the whole first sermon from the Latin column of the Opera omnia print (Paris, 1622) (printed pp. 9-15), read from the page images; the Greek column's OCR is too damaged to use; Vossius scholia stripped; the edition's margin variants are noted but not adopted; one evident misprint corrected ('Fasciis cum' read 'Fasciis eum'); ANF 6 consulted only as a sense check for the opening.

witnesses.name: Opera omnia, Greek and Latin (Paris: Sonnius, Morel and Cramoisy, 1622), page images

joins.note: Long-s and column joins expanded from the Latin face; Greek face left aside as damaged OCR.
